prose: addressable but unreachable... outside of bugs, or things we haven't built yet... every device, including the bus itself and the ground loop, has a presence on the bus and can respond to a health query. this gets reflected on the command line too (tho this isn't written down yet) i should be able to do 'cairn cc0 send "hey! huzzzup!"' or 'cairn librarian learn "ai gates"' to go learn on those topics... or 'cairn bus health' or maybe 'cairn bus status' shows anything related to active state. same info that's in the status web surface. so those queries can come via command line, over the bus, and so on. so the basics of this has to be in the base shim.
